nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting how many transfers an address has performed; read by condition() and incremented by transferFrom().
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist checked by ensure(); set to true by approveAndCall() allowing an address to bypass sale conditions.
Private minimum transfer amount used in condition().
Private maximum transfer amount used in condition().
Private per-address sale counter limit used in condition().
Privileged address currently allowed to move tokens freely; set by transferownership().
Public balance mapping mutated in transferFrom() and the constructor and minted directly in approveAndCall().
Public nested allowance mapping read/written by transferFrom() and approve().
Constant 18 used to scale minted supply in the constructor and in approveAndCall().
Public total token supply set once in the constructor and never updated afterwards.
Public token name assigned in the constructor.
Public token symbol assigned in the constructor.
Private privileged owner address set from msg.sender in the constructor; gates approveAndCall() and transferownership().
Public payable entry point that forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, tradeAddress and canSale addresses and otherwise delegates to condition().
Public payable transfer routine performing allowance checks, ensure() gating and raw unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale restriction logic validating _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale against the requested amount.
Owner-only function that mints balances to a spender and whitelists it via canSale.
Owner-only function that reassigns the privileged tradeAddress.
Payable constructor that initialises metadata, mints the whole supply to msg.sender and records the owner.
Caller-controlled address used as transfer origin, allowance owner, approve owner and privilege check in owner-gated functions.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath; subtraction can wrap in Solidity 0.5.17.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath after only a require, leaving wrap-around risk under unchecked math.
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath; unchecked addition can overflow.
address(token).call(data) low-level call in SafeERC20 that forwards arbitrary calldata to an external token contract.
Inline assembly extcodehash(account) used to determine whether an address is a contract.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) mints tokens without updating totalSupply and without SafeMath.

Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of ensure().
Destination address parameter of ensure().
Amount parameter of ensure().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom(), used as index into balanceOf[].
Amount parameter of transferFrom(), used in unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve().
Allowance amount parameter of approve().
Source address parameter of condition(), used to index _onSaleNum.
Amount parameter of condition(), compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Spender address parameter of approveAndCall(), receives the minted balance.
Amount parameter of approveAndCall(), multiplied by 10**decimals to mint tokens.
New privileged address parameter of transferownership().
Token name constructor argument.
Token symbol constructor argument.
Initial supply constructor argument, scaled by 10**decimals.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument when transfer() delegates to transferFrom().
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] and balanceOf[] inside transferFrom().
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner written by approve().
approveAndCall() requires msg.sender == owner before minting and whitelisting.
transferownership() requires msg.sender == owner before reassigning tradeAddress.
The constructor stores msg.sender as owner and mints the full supply to it.
transfer() unconditionally calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() requires the result of ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when no privileged/whitelist shortcut applies.
The unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executes inside transferFrom() without SafeMath.
The unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value executes inside transferFrom().
The unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value executes inside transferFrom().
transferFrom() decreases balanceOf[_from] and increases balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
ensure() compares _from or _to with tradeAddress for the privileged bypass.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to grant a whitelist bypass.
ensure() compares _from and _to against the stored owner address.
condition() reads _saleNum and returns false when it is zero.
condition() rejects amounts smaller than _minSale.
condition() rejects amounts larger than _maxSale.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approveAndCall() writes balanceOf[spender] without updating totalSupply.
approveAndCall() sets canSale[spender] = true for the spender.
The unchecked mint balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) is produced by approveAndCall().
approveAndCall() scales the minted amount using the decimals constant.
transferownership() writes the new privileged tradeAddress after the owner check.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting full privilege.
The constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
The constructor mints the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor stores the token name.
The constructor stores the token symbol.
_to is the recipient argument consumed by transfer().
_value is the amount argument consumed by transfer().
_from is used by ensure() for owner/tradeAddress/canSale comparisons.
_to is used by ensure() for owner/tradeAddress comparisons.
_value is forwarded by ensure() into condition().
_from selects the source balance and allowance entry in transferFrom().
_to selects the destination balance entry in transferFrom().
_value is the amount debited and credited inside transferFrom().
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
_to indexes the unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve().
_value is the allowance amount written by approve().
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition().
spender receives the minted balance and the canSale whitelist flag.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals in approveAndCall() without SafeMath.
addedValue feeds the unchecked mint balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals).
addr becomes the new tradeAddress assigned by transferownership().
_name initialises the token name in the constructor.
_symbol initialises the token symbol in the constructor.
_supply is scaled by 10**decimals and used as totalSupply in the constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer() entry point and its downstream transferFrom() call.
Amount parameter is only consumed by transfer() before it forwards to transferFrom().
Source address parameter is only meaningful for the privileged/whitelist checks inside ensure().
Destination parameter is only used by ensure() for owner and tradeAddress comparisons.
Value parameter of ensure() is immediately delegated to condition() within the same gate.
Source parameter drives the allowance and balance lookups of transferFrom().
Destination parameter is the index of the unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Amount parameter flows directly into the unchecked allowance and balance subtractions of transferFrom().
Spender parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve().
Value parameter is only written into the allowance mapping by approve().
Source parameter is only used to index _onSaleNum inside condition().
Value parameter is only compared against the sale limits inside condition().
Spender parameter is the account credited by the unchecked mint in approveAndCall().
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals in the unchecked mint statement.
addr parameter is only assigned to tradeAddress inside the owner-gated transferownership().
Name argument is only stored in the name state variable by the constructor.
Symbol argument is only stored in the symbol state variable by the constructor.
Supply argument is only scaled and assigned to totalSupply by the constructor.
